newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends up, flour mill buying cited.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends up, flour mill buying cited.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures closed higher, with flour mill buying providing an early boost to prices, floor sources said.
Gains in CBOT and KCBT wheat markets provided added incentive to buy MGE wheat, they said.
Volume was light largely because cash grain markets were slow to start up after the holidays and many grain futures traders will not return until Monday, they said.

Peavey bought about 1.0 million bushels of March wheat and 500,000 of May, while Country Hedging sold 1.0 million March and LFG sold 1.0 million March and 300,000 July and bought 400,000 of March, traders said.
MGE wheat closed up 4-3/4 to one cent, with March 4-1/4 higher at $3.82 per bushel.
